browser.defaultUrl.description: Default URL to open in the browser (Home target). Change the port by editing this URL.
browser.retainContextWhenHidden.descript: Keep the page state (scroll, forms, JS state, websockets) alive while the view is hidden. Takes effect after reload.
browser.proxyEnabled.description: Route pages through a local per-target proxy (*.localhost) that strips frame-blocking headers (X-Frame-Options / CSP frame-ancestors), rewrites nested iframes, holds session cookies per target origin, and accepts self-signed local certs. Sites that need real browser OAuth or exact https:// origin checks still need Open in external browser.
